mission: Measure bounded learning/reality observations without promoting them into causal, credential, or scientific truth.
reality_debt: No real learner cohort is included in R0.3.
No randomized controlled study is executed by this package.
Caller-supplied independence/randomization/holdout flags are not externally authenticated.
No benchmark secrecy guarantee exists merely because generator_exposed=false.
No causal effect size, statistical significance, retention, or long-horizon transfer claim is established.
next_discriminating_experiments: Synthetic negative controls that must produce zero or negative observed gain.
Independent held-out benchmark families with manifest separation.
Baseline-vs-intervention difference-in-differences under a preregistered protocol.
Prerequisite ablation across multiple target capabilities and cohorts.
Reality-anchor bridge from simulated tasks to independently measured physical or operational tasks where appropriate.
